diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all rollouts because the decision-maker used the fact S2, which states 'The portable ultrasound is currently assigned to the emergency department.' This fact is accessible to the decision-maker and does not require the hidden information PF1 or PF2. Since the decision-maker can always assign the portable ultrasound to the emergency department based on this fact, check C1 is effectively bypassed without needing the hidden information.

C1.why: The scheduled procedure changes the assignment to the emergency department and fixes the portable-machine window at exactly 22:00-23:00 instead of leaving either choice open.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C1 to require the decision-maker to consider the specific time window for the portable ultrasound as specified in PF1. Specifically, modify check C1 to ensure that the decision-maker cannot assign the portable ultrasound to the emergency department outside the time window fixed by PF1 (i.e., 22:00-23:00). This will prevent the decision-maker from making a generic assignment that does not depend on the hidden information.
